title: xi dats build list
description: The projects `xi dats build --list` builds, in order, each on top of the ones before it. With --reset every table any of them edits in place (database records, zone dialog, NPC names and events, spell / command records) is first reset from its .base, once, so projects that share a table layer the same way every time. projects/build_list.json by default; `xi dats build NAME --list` builds projects/NAME.json.

projects.description: Each project: a name (projects/<name>.json), or a path to a project file relative to this file (a zone editor project's dats.json). Built first to last.

result.description: Written by each --list build: per target, the tables the projects edit in place. A --list --reset resets these too, so a table a project no longer edits (or a project taken off the list) goes back as well.

examples.description: The server's client build: the base tweaks, then the Abyssea content, then the zone editor's cutscenes.
